content:
Tomorrow is Apple's biggest annual product event, and new Apple Watch models are expected to be unveiled. But in an unprecedented move, all versions of the Apple Watch SE 3 have become completely unavailable for purchase on Apple's official website.

Apple's official website shows that all Apple Watch SE 3 models are "currently unavailable."

The outside world expects Apple to launch new iPhone and Apple Watch models at its event on September 9, and quite possibly AirPods and other products as well.

And before the event takes place, one of the existing Apple Watch models — the Apple Watch SE 3 — has become unavailable for purchase on Apple's official website.

As discovered by MacRumors, no matter how you configure any version of the Apple Watch SE 3, Apple's website will display that the model is "currently unavailable" at the final step. Whether it's the delivery option or picking it up in person at an Apple Store, the situation is the same.

Apple generally does not clear out inventory of existing products before launching a new generation.

But what's particularly strange about this move is that there have not been any rumors whatsoever about an Apple Watch SE 4 launching tomorrow.

We expect that the only new models to be launched tomorrow will be the Apple Watch Series 12 and the Ultra 4.

The current unavailable status may simply be a system error that will be resolved soon. But for now, it seems to hint that a new generation of the Apple Watch SE may make its debut tomorrow.

We will continue to follow up on any updates regarding the availability of the Apple Watch SE 3.
